silhouette: A mostly rectangular central board, with a wide horizontal rail above the main tile-and-blocker field. The board and its visible contents are unobscured.
spatial_structure: The upper part is a shallow, nearly full-width tile area. Below it, a central rectangular blocker mass is flanked by narrow vertical compartments along both sides; two distinct compartments sit at the bottom center.
symmetry: Approximately bilateral around the vertical axis: the side compartments and central blocker mass are arranged in a broadly mirrored pattern.
element_placement: A single visible horizontal rail spans the width above the main field. The main field has a shallow upper tile band, a central block of wooden and patterned crates, matching side stacks of shield-like objects, and two multicolored compartments along the bottom center.
notable_features: The broad horizontal rail is visually separated from the main board area, and the lower side compartments sit beside—not beneath—the central crate mass.

proposed_tags.why: A narrow decorative or blocker-like row spans the board above the main field.
A compact central blocker block is bordered on both sides by vertical compartments.
The central mass visibly changes from plain wooden crates to patterned crates in successive rows.

silhouette: An irregular, stepped outline: a raised rectangular section occupies the upper right, while a lower rectangular section extends left from the bottom.
spatial_structure: A compact tile area at lower left meets a broad field of circular blockers at upper right. Five tall vertical columns stand between these areas, with their tops descending in a staircase toward the right.
symmetry: Strongly asymmetric; the lower-left tile area and the stepped upper-right blocker field do not mirror one another.
element_placement: A dense array of circular blockers fills the upper-right area. Five tall, pale columns form a descending row of vertical barriers. Match tiles occupy the lower-left rectangle, with several special-looking pieces along its bottom row.
notable_features: The tall columns have visibly staggered top edges, creating a diagonal step pattern inside the board as well as along its irregular outline.

proposed_tags.why: The tops of five adjacent tall columns descend in sequence from left to right.
A lower-left tile rectangle extends from the base of a larger upper-right section.
Circular blockers occupy a concentrated field in the upper-right portion of the board.

silhouette: The visible board has a broadly rectangular outer outline, with a tall narrow section along the left and a wider upper-right area above a lower compartment bank.
spatial_structure: Three tall columns occupy the far left. In the upper-right area, crates, a broad foliage-covered strip, and a narrow tile area form adjacent vertical zones. A horizontal gap separates this upper area from a two-row bank of compartments below.
symmetry: Strongly asymmetric, with a tall left-side column group, upper-right tile pocket, and offset lower compartment bank.
element_placement: Three tall pale columns run down the left side. Wooden crates occupy the upper middle-left, dense green foliage forms a broad vertical strip beside them, and visible match tiles sit at the far right. Six blue-and-gold compartments are arranged in two rows of three at the bottom right.
notable_features: The upper tile area and lower compartment bank are separated by a conspicuous horizontal band, while the left columns continue alongside both sections.

proposed_tags.why: Three tall pale columns form an uninterrupted vertical stack along the left edge.
A broad, continuous strip of foliage separates crates from the right-side tiles.
A two-by-three compartment bank sits below a horizontal gap and to the right of the tall side columns.

silhouette: A broad upper section narrows into a central vertical channel, while lower side sections extend down around a narrower bottom-center section.
spatial_structure: Visible tiles occupy the upper left and upper right around a tall, narrow central run of translucent columns. Wooden crates form large flanking masses below the upper tile pockets; a narrow central passage continues between them to a horizontal row of blue-and-gold elements near the bottom.
symmetry: Approximately bilateral around the vertical axis: the central channel and lower flanking masses are broadly balanced, though the side openings and upper tile arrangements differ.
element_placement: Match tiles and other colorful pieces occupy the upper outer zones. Three tall translucent columns stand in the center and end above a small purple block and central emblem. Wooden crates fill the lower left and right flanks; a blue-and-gold row crosses the lower center.
notable_features: The central vertical column group visually divides the upper tile zones, then narrows to a small central base between the crate masses.

proposed_tags.why: A narrow, uninterrupted vertical route is visually framed by the upper pockets and lower crate masses.
Large wooden-crate blocks occupy the lower left and right on either side of the central route.
Tile-filled areas sit to either side of the tall central columns in the upper board.

silhouette: The board is fully visible. Its lower tile field is broad at the top and narrows through two centered steps into a short bottom tail; above it are several horizontal rows of shield-shaped cells around a central pedestal.
spatial_structure: A broad lower play area connects to the shield rows above. The pedestal occupies the center of one upper row, with shield-shaped cells flanking it; no obvious disconnected regions are visible.
symmetry: The outer shape is approximately symmetric about the vertical centerline. The central pedestal and much of the shield arrangement follow that axis, though individual pieces in the lower field do not.
element_placement: Four horizontal rows of blue shield-like cells sit above the colored-piece field, arranged around a central pedestal. The lower field contains several rows of colored pieces and scattered special-looking pieces; the bottom rows are shorter and centered.
notable_features: The central pedestal sits within a gap in one shield row. The dark-mode background makes the upper board boundary less distinct, but the visible cell arrangement can be seen.

proposed_tags.why: The lower edge steps inward symmetrically to a short centered final row.
A raised central pedestal interrupts a horizontal band of shield-shaped cells.
Shield-shaped cells occupy the upper rows while ordinary colored pieces fill the lower field.

silhouette: A fully visible, regular rectangular grid with straight outer edges.
spatial_structure: The grid is a single contiguous field. Its left and right halves form distinct vertical zones, with a visible horizontal change in the left-side elements around the middle of the board.
symmetry: The outline is rectangular, but the element arrangement is not mirrored across either axis. The left and right halves contain different-looking elements.
element_placement: Repeated face-like cells occupy the upper left portion, with crate-like cells in the lower left. Repeated yellow-and-red curled elements fill the right half from top to bottom. The visible layout has adjacent zones rather than separate regions.
notable_features: A strong vertical material split divides the board into a left zone that changes from face-like cells to crates and a right zone of repeated curled elements.

proposed_tags.why: The left and right halves have consistently different visible element types.
The left-side face-like cells give way to crate-like cells across a horizontal boundary.

silhouette: The board has a stepped outline: a narrower upper section widens at the sides, then the lower portion forms a broad central body with inset bottom pockets.
spatial_structure: One contiguous field contains a dense lower central area. Side protrusions flank the upper-middle rows, while two large bottom pockets are separated by a narrow central gap.
symmetry: The outline and the two bottom pockets are approximately mirrored about the vertical centerline. The upper colored pieces and scattered special-looking pieces are not perfectly mirrored.
element_placement: Colored pieces and a few special-looking elements occupy the upper rows. Purple and magenta covered-looking cells concentrate through the center and lower rows, with purple elements at the outer sides and two large purple pockets at the bottom; each pocket visibly contains a yellow circular element.
notable_features: The lower center is dominated by a dense block of repeated magenta cells, flanked at the bottom by a pair of large, similarly shaped pockets.

proposed_tags.why: Two large bottom pockets sit side by side with a narrow gap between them.
Repeated magenta covered-looking cells form a dense cluster across the lower center.
A yellow circular element is visible inside each of the two bottom pockets.

silhouette: The board combines a wide, shallow rectangular upper section with a broad lower section. A narrow central connector links them; the lower section is shaped into two large rounded lobes.
spatial_structure: The upper grid connects to the lower area through a narrow central passage. The lower area has two broad side bays with curved, loop-like turquoise paths and a narrow central division.
symmetry: The main silhouette and the two lower loop-like bays are strongly mirrored about the vertical centerline. Individual pieces and special-looking elements in the upper grid are not perfectly mirrored.
element_placement: Colored pieces and special-looking elements fill the upper grid, with a row of blue cup-like pieces along its lower edge. Large turquoise covered-looking areas occupy the lower lobes, with circular target-like symbols arranged along their inner edges.
notable_features: The paired curved lower areas create a looped, mirrored pattern, and the narrow central passage visibly links the upper grid to the lower section.

proposed_tags.why: A narrow central passage links the upper grid to the broader lower area.
The lower region contains two large, similarly shaped curved bays.
Circular target-like symbols repeat along the inner edges of both lower bays.

silhouette: The visible tile field is broad and nearly rectangular, with the lower left and right corners cut back to leave a short, centered extension at the bottom.
spatial_structure: One continuous, open tile field with no visible internal compartments or narrow corridors.
symmetry: The outer boundary is approximately mirrored across the vertical centerline. Tile and special-piece placements are not fully mirrored.
element_placement: Colored pieces fill the visible field in a single layer. A few visibly marked or striped pieces sit among them, including near the right side and lower-right edge; no large blocker patch is apparent.
notable_features: A narrow blue tab overlaps the upper edge of the tile field near the right of center. Characters and scenery above it are outside the tile grid.

proposed_tags.why: The broad field narrows at both lower corners and retains a short centered extension.
A few visibly distinct marked or striped pieces are interspersed in an otherwise regular field.

silhouette: The visible board spans a broad upper area and a lower tile field whose outline steps inward at the lower corners, leaving a centered bottom extension.
spatial_structure: An open upper area sits above the dense lower tile grid. A horizontal band of magenta textured cells and shield-like pieces visually separates the two areas.
symmetry: The upper arrangement and overall outline are approximately balanced around the vertical centerline, with a central statue and flanking figures. The lower pieces and marked cells are not fully mirrored.
element_placement: In the upper area, a large stone figure is centered between two smaller figures; shield-like pieces flank a horizontal magenta band. The lower area is a single visible tile layer containing colored pieces and several visibly distinct marked or framed squares.
notable_features: The board combines a relatively open upper shelf with a densely populated lower field; the magenta band is interrupted by shield-like elements.

proposed_tags.why: A broad upper shelf is visually distinct from the populated lower tile field.
A horizontal strip of magenta cells and shield-like pieces spans the board between the upper and lower areas.
The lower boundary steps inward on both sides and continues as a short centered extension.

silhouette: The visible lower tile field has a central notch in its top edge and a stepped lower outline, with the bottom corners cut back. A darker upper chamber occupies much of the area above it and is linked visually by a narrow central passage.
spatial_structure: The board reads as a large upper chamber, a narrow central connector, and a broad lower tile field. A separate narrow route is visible along the upper-right side.
symmetry: The lower field outline is roughly balanced around the vertical centerline, but visible objects and pieces are unevenly placed, especially in the upper chamber.
element_placement: Three small wrapped figures sit in a row at the upper left, while a raised round structure is at the upper right. The lower field contains a single layer of colored pieces and several visibly distinct marked or striped pieces.
notable_features: The upper and lower areas differ strongly in appearance: the upper chamber is dark and mostly open, while the lower field is densely filled with colored pieces. A small glowing feature appears at the far right of the upper area.

proposed_tags.why: A narrow central passage visually links the large upper chamber to the lower tile field.
A distinct narrow route follows the upper-right edge of the chamber.
Visible figures and a raised structure are positioned in the upper chamber, apart from the lower pieces.

silhouette: The visible board begins as a broad rectangle and becomes irregular in its lower half, with stepped recesses along the left side and bottom. A tall framed area projects inward from the left.
spatial_structure: A dense rectangular patch occupies the upper-left portion, while colored pieces form a broad right-side field. Below them, stepped open-looking areas and two framed pockets interrupt the left and lower-middle portions.
symmetry: Strongly asymmetric: the upper-left is dominated by a block of brown barrel-like elements, whereas the right side contains mostly colored pieces and marked cells.
element_placement: Brown barrel-like elements occupy a dense patch about five columns wide and four rows tall in the upper-left. Colored pieces and visibly marked green cells occupy the right and lower areas in a single visible layer. Two framed pockets, one left of center and one near the lower middle, each contain three red hanging elements.
notable_features: The barrel patch ends in a clean rectangular edge above a much more irregular lower layout. The two framed pockets are distinct from the surrounding tile field.

proposed_tags.why: A contiguous rectangular cluster of barrel-like elements fills a large upper-left section.
Two separate framed recesses contain matching groups of three red hanging elements.
The lower-left boundary and adjacent interior areas form several visible stepped recesses.

silhouette: La zona inferior es casi rectangular y ocupa casi todo el ancho. Su borde inferior tiene una muesca central irregular; encima, una franja horizontal amplia conecta visualmente los lados. El contorno del tablero se ve completo.
spatial_structure: Una barrera luminosa atraviesa horizontalmente la zona superior, separada de la cuadrícula inferior por una fila de escudos. La cuadrícula inferior forma un bloque ancho con una abertura irregular en la parte central baja. Hay figuras verdes cerca de los extremos laterales. Se distinguen una franja de escudos y, debajo, varias filas de fichas y elementos.
symmetry: El bloque inferior se aproxima a la simetría izquierda-derecha, pero la muesca central y los elementos visibles no coinciden exactamente entre ambos lados. La franja de barrera es horizontal y casi simétrica.
element_placement: Una línea luminosa cruza el campo superior; una fila de escudos se extiende sobre la cuadrícula de fichas. En la cuadrícula hay fichas de colores y elementos con aspecto de escudo o explosivo. Elementos rocosos oscuros ocupan la muesca central inferior. Se aprecian varias capas verticales de elementos.
notable_features: La barrera luminosa de lado a lado y la fila de escudos crean dos franjas horizontales muy marcadas. El modo oscuro hace que estos elementos resalten.

proposed_tags.why: Una barra luminosa continua cruza horizontalmente casi todo el campo visible.
Una fila continua de escudos se extiende a lo largo del borde superior de la cuadrícula inferior.
El contorno inferior se interrumpe con una muesca amplia y escalonada en el centro.

silhouette: Contorno irregular escalonado, ancho en la parte superior izquierda y con extensiones hacia el centro y la derecha. La zona baja se ensancha hacia ambos lados en distintos niveles; el borde completo es visible.
spatial_structure: Las fichas ocupan principalmente el bloque superior izquierdo. Una zona de barriles ocupa el centro superior y medio, mientras que celdas cubiertas con marcas diagonales forman un bloque en el lado derecho y continúan en una franja inferior. En la parte baja hay una cavidad central verde con objetos curvos y un pequeño elemento morado; celdas moradas también aparecen junto al borde derecho e inferior. Se distinguen varias capas de materiales y cubiertas.
symmetry: Marcadamente asimétrico: la zona de fichas está concentrada a la izquierda, mientras que las celdas cubiertas y otros elementos se agrupan de manera desigual a la derecha y abajo. No se aprecia un eje de simetría.
element_placement: Las fichas de colores y elementos con aspecto de objetivo o explosivo se concentran arriba a la izquierda. Barriles marrones cubren celdas en la parte superior central y media; paneles azulados con marcas diagonales forman bloques contiguos a la derecha y abajo. En la zona inferior central hay un compartimento verde con dos elementos curvos y una gema pequeña, junto a celdas moradas en los bordes derecho e inferior.
notable_features: El tablero combina grupos de cubiertas visualmente distintos —barriles, paneles diagonales y celdas moradas— dentro de un contorno escalonado.

proposed_tags.why: Barriles, paneles diagonales y celdas moradas forman grupos contiguos de cubiertas distintas.
Las fichas y varios elementos destacados se agrupan en la zona superior izquierda, en vez de repartirse por el tablero.
Un compartimento verde con elementos curvos ocupa una cavidad en el tramo inferior del tablero.

silhouette: La parte superior es un rectángulo ancho. El contorno se prolonga hacia abajo de forma desigual: una extensión ocupa la zona inferior izquierda y otra, más amplia y rectangular, la inferior derecha, con un segmento estrecho entre ambas. El tablero se ve completo.
spatial_structure: La cuadrícula superior contiene varias filas de fichas y celdas cubiertas. Debajo, una extensión inferior izquierda y un gran compartimento claro inferior derecho quedan separados parcialmente por una franja vertical estrecha de celdas escalonadas. El lado derecho también se prolonga bajo la cuadrícula superior. Se distinguen varias capas de fichas, celdas redondas cubiertas, celdas moradas y una zona clara con patrón de rompecabezas.
symmetry: La fila superior se acerca a una distribución equilibrada alrededor del eje vertical, pero las extensiones inferiores son muy distintas. En conjunto, el tablero es asimétrico.
element_placement: Fichas de colores se concentran en la parte superior izquierda. Celdas con anillos turquesa, discos marrones y celdas moradas ocupan distintos bloques de la cuadrícula superior y sus extensiones. Un área grande, clara y con patrón de rompecabezas ocupa la parte inferior derecha; una franja vertical estrecha con bandas de color queda entre esta área y la extensión inferior izquierda.
notable_features: El gran campo claro con patrón de rompecabezas contrasta con las celdas pequeñas y densamente cubiertas que lo rodean.

proposed_tags.why: Una amplia zona clara con patrón de rompecabezas ocupa un compartimento separado del bloque principal de fichas.
Una franja vertical estrecha de celdas escalonadas queda entre las dos extensiones inferiores.
Varios grupos visibles de discos marrones y celdas con anillos turquesa ocupan filas de la cuadrícula.

silhouette: Un rectángulo ancho y regular con bordes rectos y esquinas aproximadamente cuadradas. El contorno completo es visible.
spatial_structure: Una gran zona rectangular de celdas rosadas cubiertas ocupa la mayor parte de la mitad superior. Las fichas visibles forman una franja compacta de tres filas a todo lo ancho en la parte inferior. La transición entre ambas zonas es horizontal y recta.
symmetry: El contorno es simétrico respecto de los ejes vertical y horizontal. La franja inferior de fichas tiene una distribución aproximadamente, pero no exactamente, simétrica.
element_placement: Las celdas rosadas cubiertas llenan la parte superior, con múltiples filas y columnas de aspecto uniforme. En las tres filas inferiores hay fichas de varios colores y algunos elementos destacados cerca de los extremos. La separación entre la zona cubierta y la franja de fichas es claramente horizontal.
notable_features: La diferencia visual entre la gran zona cubierta y la franja inferior de fichas domina la composición del tablero.

proposed_tags.why: Una masa rectangular de celdas cubiertas ocupa todo el ancho por encima de las fichas visibles.
Las fichas visibles se concentran en una franja de pocas filas que recorre el ancho inferior.
Una cubierta de apariencia uniforme forma un bloque amplio y continuo en la parte superior.

silhouette: A broad, approximately rectangular board. The visible cells form a narrow exposed strip along the left, three short upright sections near the top, and several inset openings within the larger covered area.
spatial_structure: Most of the middle and right side is occupied by a continuous leafy field. The exposed left-side cells form a vertical route; small framed compartments and cabinet-like groups are set into the leafy area.
symmetry: The board and major placements are strongly asymmetric: the exposed route is on the left, while the covered field and its openings dominate the middle and right.
element_placement: A broad leafy covering spans the center and right, interrupted by two upper framed purple compartments and four cabinet-like groups below. Three short, two-cell blue stacks are visible along the top edge. Other pieces are exposed in the left-side strip. The visible covering appears to be one surface layer.
notable_features: The large continuous covering contains several distinct openings with different visible contents, while the three blue stacks sit above its upper edge.

proposed_tags.why: A broad visible covering is punctuated by small, separately framed openings containing other elements.
Most exposed pieces form a continuous narrow strip along the left boundary beside the covered field.

silhouette: A vertically oriented board with broad left and right banks connected around a narrower central section; shallow notches interrupt the top and bottom outlines.
spatial_structure: The board is arranged as two tall side banks flanking a central vertical stack of four framed blue compartments. The side banks remain visibly distinct in content, with repeated circular pieces on the left and a mixed candy area on the right.
symmetry: The outer boundary and major central stack are approximately mirrored across a vertical axis. The pieces within the left and right banks are visibly different, so the contents are not mirrored.
element_placement: Four framed blue compartments are stacked vertically in the center. Repeated circular elements and a central line of red-and-white targets fill the left bank; mixed pieces fill the right bank. Matching penguin-like pieces appear along the top of both side banks. The central stack forms one repeated visible layer.
notable_features: The central compartments form an unusually regular four-part vertical stack between two tall side banks.

proposed_tags.why: Four similarly framed blue compartments form a distinctive vertical stack in the center of the board.
The overall outline and center are near-mirrored, but the visible elements in the two side banks differ.

silhouette: A broad rectangular tile grid with a centered rectangular cut-in along its bottom edge, leaving a left foot and a right foot of cells.
spatial_structure: The visible grid is a single broad field with a pronounced bottom-center notch. No other internal separation is apparent in the cells.
symmetry: The outer grid boundary, including the bottom notch, is approximately symmetric about a vertical axis. The visible tile arrangement is not strictly mirrored.
element_placement: Ordinary colored pieces fill the grid. A few special-looking pieces and striped red-and-yellow elements are visible among them, including some at the outer edges. No distinct covered-cell layers are apparent. Above the grid is a separate decorative scene with a wall and two figures on platforms.
notable_features: The bottom-center cut-in is a clear interruption to the otherwise broad grid; the decorative scene above the grid is visually separate from the tiled play area.

proposed_tags.why: The bottom boundary has a prominent centered rectangular cut-in that leaves two separated-looking lower feet.

silhouette: An irregular, stepped board: a tall left section and a lower span across the center and right, with a large open area cut from the upper middle.
spatial_structure: The missing upper-middle cells create a broad window between the left section and the upper-right patch. The lower bank spans across the center and right beneath that opening; a narrow vertical column links the upper-right patch to the lower bank.
symmetry: The board is strongly asymmetric, with a tall left section, an upper-right cluster, and a wider lower-right bank.
element_placement: Repeated ornate red-and-gold elements line the left section around a narrow vertical purple strip. A compact mixed-piece cluster occupies the upper-right patch. Across the lower bank, a row of penguin-like pieces sits atop repeated tall purple compartments. The visible compartments form one repeated row beneath that line.
notable_features: The upper-middle void exposes the background and separates the upper-right patch from the left section; the lower bank has a conspicuous row of matching pieces immediately above repeated compartments.

proposed_tags.why: A large opening in the upper middle exposes the background between the tall left section and the right-side area.
A horizontal row of matching pieces sits directly above the repeated tall compartments in the lower bank.

silhouette: Two broad, shallow rectangular framed areas are visible, one above the other with a narrow background gap between them. The upper area contains a narrower central inset lane; the lower area appears empty apart from a hanging marker.
spatial_structure: In the upper area, a narrow central vertical lane of tiles is framed by two tall columns and a short horizontal bar near its base. Wider side compartments flank the lane. A separate-looking wide lower rectangle has no visible tiles.
symmetry: The upper lane and framing are approximately symmetrical about the vertical axis. The side hanging markers differ in color and number; the lower marker is centered.
element_placement: Colored pieces and round special-looking pieces occupy the central lane, with a few pieces along its lower edge. Tall pale columns sit on either side, and a horizontal bar with end fixtures crosses the lane near the bottom. Hanging numbered markers are positioned in the two side compartments and at the center of the lower rectangle. One visible layer of pieces and solid fixtures.
notable_features: The central tile lane is much narrower than the framed upper area, and the broad lower framed area is visibly unfilled. No popup or tutorial overlay obscures the board.

proposed_tags.why: A narrow central tile lane sits between tall internal columns within a much wider upper area.
Two broad rectangular framed areas are visible, separated by a narrow gap.
Numbered markers hang in the outer side compartments and at the center of the lower area.

silhouette: A single wide rectangular board with a regular outer boundary.
spatial_structure: The upper part is mostly occupied by a pink cell pattern, with the visible pieces concentrated in a horizontal band toward the upper right. Two long horizontal bars cross much of the board at different heights. Rows of barrel-shaped blocks and a dense wooden-crate band fill the lower portion.
symmetry: The outer boundary is rectangular, but the internal arrangement is asymmetric: the horizontal bars end at the right, and pieces and blockers are unevenly distributed.
element_placement: Pink square cells cover much of the upper and left interior. Colored pieces and round special-looking pieces cluster in the upper-right band. Two pale horizontal bars with rounded end fixtures sit at separate heights; barrel-shaped blocks occupy rows between and below them. Wooden crate-like blocks form two dense bottom rows. These elements appear in distinct horizontal bands.
notable_features: The two long bars and intervening barrel rows create repeated horizontal obstruction bands above the bottom crate rows. No popup or tutorial overlay obscures the board.

proposed_tags.why: Horizontal bars, barrel-shaped blocks, and crate rows form successive, visibly distinct bands.
Two continuous-looking rows of wooden crate-like blocks span the bottom of the board.
Two long horizontal bars cross the board at different heights and end on the right.

silhouette: The matching grid is a broad, shallow rectangle in the lower half of the image, with a centered recessed extension at its bottom edge. The checkerboard-like area above the grid is visually separate from the tiled board.
spatial_structure: The rectangular grid has a repeated row-and-column layout. Target-like circular markers occupy both outer columns, while colored pieces fill the interior columns. A narrow central recess extends below the grid, with several dark circular marks visible inside it.
symmetry: The board boundary and placement of the outer-column markers are approximately symmetrical about the vertical axis. The colored pieces and special-looking pieces are not an exact mirror image.
element_placement: Red-and-white circular markers run down both outer columns. Colored pieces fill the central columns, with a few special-looking pieces among them. At the bottom center, the recessed extension contains dark circular marks and is bordered by green foliage. A few small character-like figures stand above the grid; they are outside the tiled board.
notable_features: The paired outer marker columns frame the interior, and the bottom-center recess interrupts the otherwise straight lower boundary. No popup or tutorial overlay obscures the board.

proposed_tags.why: A centered extension or recess interrupts the lower edge of the otherwise rectangular grid.
Similar circular target-like markers form vertical columns along both outer edges.
The outer marker columns flank and visually frame the central columns of colored pieces.

silhouette: A wide rectangular upper grid narrows into a centered lower extension containing a separate-looking rectangular pocket.
spatial_structure: A chest-like object sits near the upper center, above a thick central mass of purple cells. The mass separates the left and right side strips, where rows of green flower-like pieces are visible. Below it, the board narrows into a central pocket containing red mushroom-like pieces.
symmetry: The outline and major central features are approximately symmetrical about the vertical axis. The colored pieces and special-looking pieces are not perfectly mirrored.
element_placement: Colored pieces occupy the upper rows around the centered chest-like object. A dense purple cell mass fills the center below it, while green flower-like pieces repeat in rows along both side strips. The lower central pocket contains a compact group of red mushroom-like pieces. These form distinct upper, middle, and lower placements.
notable_features: The central purple mass divides the side strips, while the lower pocket reconnects the layout through a centered extension. No popup or tutorial overlay obscures the board.

proposed_tags.why: A thick central mass separates two visible side strips containing repeated pieces.
A distinct pocket at the bottom center contains a compact group of mushroom-like pieces.
The chest and pieces above, central purple mass and side rows, and lower pocket form three visible vertical zones.

silhouette: An irregular, connected board with a broad upper-left section, a narrow extension across the upper right, and a lower-left section; the lower edge has a central recess and a small lower-right extension.
spatial_structure: Narrow striped-looking cells wind between and around three large, separate purple covered-cell blocks. Brown blocker cells line parts of the outer edge, and a small framed cell group sits near the lower center-right.
symmetry: Strongly asymmetric; the covered blocks and playable extensions do not mirror across either axis.
element_placement: Three dense purple covered-cell blocks occupy the upper-right, middle-left, and lower-left interior. Brown blockers cluster along the upper and lower edges and the far right. The small framed multicolored group is near the lower center-right; a separate music-note tile is just to its right.
notable_features: A narrow pink-and-yellow striped-looking route visibly threads around the purple blocks. The board boundary and the internal covered-cell blocks are distinct.

proposed_tags.why: Three separate covered-cell blocks are distributed diagonally across the board rather than gathered in one region.
A narrow striped-looking path bends around multiple interior covered blocks.
Brown blocker cells appear in distinct clusters along the board perimeter.

silhouette: Two tall, irregular board sections sit side by side with a visible gap between them. The left section is wider at the top and continues into a large lower block; the right section is a taller, stepped panel.
spatial_structure: The left section has an open upper area above a broad purple covered-cell block. The right section contains repeated rows of round blue-and-gold pieces and chain-marked cells, with several framed pockets along its outer right edge.
symmetry: Strongly asymmetric; the two side-by-side sections differ in size, contents, and internal arrangement.
element_placement: Purple covered cells fill much of the lower-left section. On the right, blue-and-gold round pieces cluster in inner columns, chain-marked cells occupy adjacent columns and rows, and four purple-symbol framed pockets are spaced along the far-right side. The visible elements form multiple distinct bands rather than a single layer.
notable_features: A clear gap separates the two board sections. The framed purple-symbol pockets repeat at intervals along the right edge.

symmetry: Los paneles tienen alturas y anchuras parecidas y están colocados a izquierda y derecha, pero sus elementos internos son distintos; la simetría del conjunto es solo aproximada.
element_placement: En el panel izquierdo, cinco gabinetes se apilan junto a dos columnas de bloques morados. En el derecho, las piezas ocupan la parte superior y cuatro columnas de tubos metálicos, de alturas escalonadas, terminan en bases moradas en la parte inferior.
notable_features: Las columnas de tubos forman una progresión de alturas: la primera comienza más arriba y las siguientes comienzan progresivamente más abajo hacia la derecha.

proposed_tags.why: Las cuatro columnas de tubos visibles comienzan a distintas alturas, en una progresión descendente de izquierda a derecha.
Cinco gabinetes se repiten verticalmente en una columna del panel izquierdo.
Dos paneles de proporciones similares flanquean un amplio espacio vacío, aunque su contenido difiere.

silhouette: La forma combina bandas anchas superior, media e inferior con una conexión central más estrecha. Entrantes laterales profundos dejan una extensión central entre las zonas inferiores izquierda y derecha.
spatial_structure: Una columna central conecta las bandas anchas. En la banda media, dos paneles azules horizontales flanquean una columna estrecha de copas moradas. Los bloques morados oscuros se concentran en los bordes de las bandas superior e inferior.
symmetry: La forma y la distribución principal muestran una simetría bilateral vertical marcada; los paneles azules están emparejados a ambos lados del centro.
element_placement: Los bloques oscuros enmarcan la parte superior e inferior. En el centro hay piezas y potenciadores; dos paneles azules cubiertos ocupan los lados izquierdo y derecho de la banda media, junto a una línea vertical central de copas. Se distinguen dos paneles cubiertos visibles.
notable_features: El estrechamiento central y los entrantes laterales forman una silueta de barras conectadas por una columna. Los dos paneles azules horizontales se corresponden a ambos lados del centro.

proposed_tags.why: Una columna central estrecha conecta las bandas anchas superior, media e inferior.
Entrantes profundos a ambos lados estrechan la forma alrededor de la conexión central.
Dos paneles azules cubiertos ocupan posiciones horizontales emparejadas a los lados de la columna central.
Las principales bandas, entrantes y paneles laterales se reflejan aproximadamente respecto al eje vertical.

silhouette: La zona superior jugable está desplazada a la derecha. Más abajo, el tablero se ensancha hacia la izquierda y forma una extensión lateral inferior; el borde izquierdo y el derecho no se corresponden.
spatial_structure: Las piezas ocupan un bloque rectangular en la parte superior derecha. Debajo, una matriz amplia de cajas ocupa la zona central y derecha, mientras los compartimentos rojos se apilan a su izquierda. Hay cofres en la parte inferior izquierda.
symmetry: Marcadamente asimétrico: la zona superior solo se extiende a la derecha y los compartimentos rojos y cofres se concentran a la izquierda.
element_placement: Las piezas y potenciadores están en un bloque de cuatro columnas en la parte superior derecha. Debajo hay varias filas de cajas de madera en una matriz central-derecha. Tres compartimentos rojos con figuras se apilan en el borde izquierdo; un elemento vertical con el número 30 queda junto a su parte inferior, y tres cofres se sitúan debajo.
notable_features: La matriz de cajas de madera ocupa una gran área entre el bloque superior derecho y la columna de compartimentos rojos del lado izquierdo.

proposed_tags.why: Tres compartimentos rojos con figuras se apilan verticalmente a lo largo del borde izquierdo.
Las cajas de madera forman una matriz rectangular densa bajo el bloque superior de piezas.
El bloque superior de piezas está desplazado a la esquina derecha y conectado con una zona inferior más ancha.

silhouette: A connected, irregular stepped outline: a tall upper-left section descends into a narrow, staggered middle before widening into a rectangular lower-right field.
spatial_structure: A populated upper-left area and a lower-right rectangular grid are separated by a long, stepped run of tall brown columns. The outline appears to connect them around the lower edge; there is no visibly open straight corridor between the two populated areas.
symmetry: Strongly asymmetric; the upper-left mass and lower-right field differ in size and position, and the boundary has no clear mirror axis.
element_placement: Tall brown column-like blockers occupy the central transition and extend to different heights. In the lower-right rectangle, blue square tiles and purple pot-shaped pieces alternate in a regular pattern. The upper-left contains ordinary colored pieces and several special-looking pieces; only one visible board layer is apparent.
notable_features: The brown columns form a conspicuous descending staircase that visually links the differently shaped upper-left and lower-right areas.

proposed_tags.why: Unequal-height brown columns occupy the transition between the upper-left area and lower-right grid.
Blue square tiles and purple pot-shaped pieces alternate regularly across the lower-right area.
The broad rectangular lower field sits to the right of the upper-left section rather than directly beneath it.

silhouette: A mostly rectangular board with a broad upper section, a narrower central connection, and a lower rectangular section; purple tube-shaped pieces protrude at both sides around the middle.
spatial_structure: The upper playable area is arranged as a grid above a broad horizontal band of wooden blocks. Side rows and a central connector lead toward the lower section, which has another dense wooden-block band near its bottom. A large character/hat overlay hides much of the central connection and part of the lower area.
symmetry: The broad outline and side protrusions are approximately mirrored across a vertical axis, but the visible colored pieces are not arranged symmetrically. The overlay limits assessment of the center.
element_placement: Wooden square blocks frame the upper grid along its sides and form a full-width horizontal band beneath it; additional wooden blocks fill much of the lower section. Purple tube-shaped pieces sit outside the left and right edges near the connector. Colored pieces and special-looking pieces are visible in the upper grid. The overlay obscures the number and placement of elements in the center and lower area.
notable_features: A large character-and-hat overlay and bright sparkle effects obscure central board cells; descriptions of that area are low confidence.

proposed_tags.why: A horizontal block band separates the broad upper grid from a distinct lower rectangular section.
Matching purple tube-shaped pieces are visible just outside both sides of the board at the middle.
The visible side tubes and broad board outline appear approximately balanced around the vertical centerline.

silhouette: A roughly vertically mirrored, stepped outline: narrow at the top, wider through the upper middle, pinched around the central obstacle, then broad again at the bottom.
spatial_structure: A wide upper field narrows around a large central rectangular blocker. Narrow vertical stacks flank that blocker, and the lower portion opens into a broad horizontal row of framed elements and small pieces.
symmetry: The outer outline and central blocker are close to vertically symmetrical. Individual colored pieces and the visible framed elements do not form a perfectly mirrored arrangement.
element_placement: A large plain orange-brown rectangle occupies the center. Narrow purple-backed stacks of repeated yellow-and-white pieces flank it. Two dark framed square elements sit at the lower left, with two brighter, translucent framed squares at the lower right; a row of repeated yellow-and-white pieces lies beneath or alongside them. One visible cell layer is apparent, with some framed elements showing a bright translucent overlay.
notable_features: The central blank rectangular blocker creates a pronounced waist, with repeated narrow stacks on either side and a dense horizontal arrangement along the bottom.

proposed_tags.why: The board narrows around a large central rectangular obstacle between wider upper and lower areas.
Repeated purple-backed stacks of yellow-and-white pieces flank the central obstacle.
The lower framed squares have visibly different appearances, with the right pair showing a bright translucent overlay.

silhouette: A broad, mostly rectangular outline with white cabinet-like blocks protruding from the left side at several heights; a full-width horizontal band divides the upper grid from the large lower area.
spatial_structure: Most visible colored pieces occupy a compact upper-right grid bordered by pink square tiles. White cabinet-like blocks form a stacked vertical group along the left side and extend outward from the main grid. A segmented horizontal barrier spans the board below this group, with a large visibly empty purple area beneath it.
symmetry: Strongly asymmetric in element placement: the cabinet-like blocks stack on the left while most colored pieces sit to the right. The horizontal barrier itself spans nearly the full width.
element_placement: Pink square tiles frame the upper-right grid, with colored pieces concentrated inside it. White cabinet-like blocks occupy a vertical left-side stack and a short lower-left extension. A segmented blue-gray band crosses the board below the grid, with small purple-and-red end pieces visible at its left and right ends. The lower area is visibly empty aside from its purple background; only one visible board layer is apparent.
notable_features: The compact upper grid and left-side cabinet stack sit above a broad cross-board barrier, leaving a large empty outlined region below.

proposed_tags.why: A segmented blue-gray band runs almost edge to edge beneath the upper grid.
Visible pieces and cabinet-like blocks are concentrated above the barrier, while the lower outlined area is empty.
White cabinet-like elements form a vertical stack with an additional pair projecting from the lower left.

silhouette: The full board is visible. Its outline is an irregular, offset shape: a broad left section joins a taller right section, with a deep notch along the upper-middle edge and stepped expansions toward the bottom. The HUD does not cover the board.
spatial_structure: The left section is mostly open, while the right section is a dense rectangular field. They connect through a stepped middle area containing several small square groups of colored vessels. A narrow non-play area separates the upper portions of the two sections.
symmetry: Strongly asymmetric overall; the left open area and right dense field do not mirror each other across either axis.
element_placement: Colored pieces and several special pieces occupy the left area. Repeated purple bear-like pieces fill most of the right field in a regular grid. A vertical stack of dark pots lines the far-right edge of the upper part of that field. Three visible 2-by-2 groups of colored vessels sit at staggered positions near the connection and lower-left area. These are distinct from the outer board boundary.
notable_features: The right-side repeated field contrasts sharply with the mixed pieces on the left. No tutorial overlay or popup obscures the initial board.

proposed_tags.why: The two differently shaped board sections connect through a stepped middle area rather than a straight, uniform join.
Bear-like pieces cover a large, regular rectangular field, distinct from the mixed pieces elsewhere.
Three small vessel groups appear as separate 2-by-2 clusters at successive positions along the board.

silhouette: The full board is visible. Its irregular outline begins partway across the top, extends into a left-side vertical projection below, and narrows in steps toward the lower-right edge. The HUD is outside the board.
spatial_structure: A compact upper-right pocket contains mixed pieces. Two tall adjacent columns occupy the left-center, with a vertical sequence of door-like elements immediately to their right. A broad mass of dark faceted blockers fills much of the lower and right portions, leaving a stepped boundary around the remaining visible areas.
symmetry: Asymmetric across both horizontal and vertical axes; the top-right pocket, left projection, and lower blocker mass have no matching counterparts.
element_placement: The paired tall metallic columns run through much of the board's left-center, with small purple squares along their left side and door-like elements along their right. Mixed pieces and special pieces cluster in the upper-right pocket. Dark faceted blockers occupy a large lower-right area and continue across the bottom in a stepped arrangement. These elements sit within the gold-outlined board boundary.
notable_features: The two adjacent vertical columns form a prominent straight band against the irregular surrounding blocker field. No popup or crop obscures the board.

proposed_tags.why: Two tall, adjacent metallic columns form a distinct parallel pair through the left-center of the board.
A contiguous dark blocker field fills the lower-right area and ends in a visibly stepped edge.
The visible mixed-piece area is concentrated in a compact upper-right pocket beside the vertical barriers.

silhouette: The full board is visible. A broad, nearly rectangular upper section spans the width, while a lower section projects from its right side; a pronounced inward step separates the lower-left edge from the upper area. The HUD does not cover the board.
spatial_structure: The upper section contains a left area with pink round pieces and door-like elements, and a large roof-patterned block across the right. A lower-right lobe extends below the upper section, with mixed pieces toward its left and pink round pieces and doors toward its right. The areas join through the broad upper-right part of the board.
symmetry: Strongly asymmetric; the roof-patterned upper-right field and the lower-right projection have no mirrored counterparts.
element_placement: Roof-patterned cells form a dense rectangular panel across the upper-right. Pink round pieces appear in rows around several door-like elements in the upper-left and lower-right. Red-and-gold fixtures line the far-left side of the upper section and form a row along its lower edge. Mixed colored and special pieces occupy the lower-left portion of the lower lobe. All are visible within the outlined board.
notable_features: A large roof-patterned panel occupies one upper quadrant, while the lower extension is offset to the right. No tutorial overlay or popup obscures the initial board.

proposed_tags.why: A dense, continuous roof-patterned panel fills a large rectangular portion of the upper-right board.
The lower board extends mainly beneath the right half of the upper section, creating an offset two-level outline.
Door-like elements appear in separate groups in the upper-left and lower-right areas rather than in one cluster.

silhouette: The full board is visible. The upper portion has a broad left area and a narrower extension on the right; a stepped inward notch leads to a wide lower section. A striped boundary element traces much of the upper-left interior. The HUD does not obscure the board.
spatial_structure: The upper-left area contains mixed pieces bordered on several sides by a thick striped element. A small square fixture sits at the lower opening of this bordered area. Paw-print containers form a dense vertical stack along the right side, continuing from the top into the lower section. Dark faceted blockers occupy most of the lower-left and lower-middle area, with a stepped edge beneath the upper section.
symmetry: Asymmetric across both axes; the right-side container column, upper-left striped enclosure, and lower blocker field are arranged differently.
element_placement: Mixed colored and special pieces occupy the upper-left interior. A thick purple-and-white striped element runs along its left, upper, and lower edges, with a small square fixture at the lower-center boundary. Paw-print containers form a repeated column at the far right. Dark faceted blockers fill much of the bottom and lower-left area, with one short row extending beneath the upper-left enclosure. All visible elements are inside the gold-outlined board.
notable_features: The striped element frames an upper-left pocket, while the repeated containers continue vertically through multiple board sections. No tutorial overlay or popup obscures the initial board.

proposed_tags.why: A thick striped element traces several sides of an interior pocket rather than sitting only at the outer board edge.
A repeated column of paw-print containers runs along the right edge from the upper area into the lower section.
Dark faceted blockers form a broad, mostly horizontal mass across the bottom of the board.

silhouette: Área visible de contorno rectangular y casi continuo, con borde marcado. La interfaz superior no tapa el tablero.
spatial_structure: La parte superior tiene tres filas anchas de celdas; debajo, el espacio visible se organiza en varios recorridos morados rectangulares anidados que rodean una zona central. El conjunto se mantiene dentro del contorno general, sin regiones claramente aisladas.
symmetry: Simetría bilateral aproximada respecto al eje vertical: los recorridos inferiores y la alternancia de obstáculos superiores se repiten a ambos lados, con pequeñas variaciones en la colocación.
element_placement: Rocas claras y piezas TNT ocupan las tres filas superiores, alternándose de forma regular. En la zona inferior, seis elementos redondos apilados en dos filas de tres están agrupados en el centro, dentro de los recorridos morados. Se aprecian varios niveles visuales de contorno alrededor de esa zona.
notable_features: Los recorridos luminosos forman un patrón de rectángulos anidados y concéntricos, inusual frente a una cuadrícula abierta convencional.

proposed_tags.why: Varios recorridos rectangulares morados rodean repetidamente una zona central.
Las rocas y las piezas TNT se concentran en una banda de tres filas en la parte superior.
Seis elementos redondos están agrupados en el centro de la estructura inferior.

silhouette: Contorno irregular y escalonado: una zona ancha arriba a la izquierda se conecta con una columna alta a la derecha y una extensión inferior más pequeña a la izquierda.
spatial_structure: La zona superior izquierda, más abierta, desemboca en una sección amplia cubierta por material marrón. Un dispositivo cilíndrico numerado aparece cerca del centro inferior; a su derecha hay una columna estrecha de material marrón, junto a una región alta y angosta de tres columnas. Una bolsa pequeña de tres por dos celdas queda en la parte inferior izquierda.
symmetry: Asimétrico; la columna derecha es alta y estrecha, mientras que las secciones izquierdas forman una zona más ancha y con salientes.
element_placement: Las piezas de juego visibles se agrupan arriba a la izquierda. El material marrón cubre la zona media izquierda y forma también una columna cerca del centro-derecha; un elemento encadenado está dentro de la sección marrón superior. Piezas redondas rosadas aparecen en una columna alta a la derecha y en una bolsa de tres por dos abajo a la izquierda. Un dispositivo cilíndrico con el número 1 está cerca del centro inferior.
notable_features: La silueta combina una región principal amplia con una columna lateral larga y una pequeña bolsa inferior separada visualmente del área superior.

proposed_tags.why: Una columna vertical larga sobresale a la derecha de la región principal del tablero.
Las piezas redondas rosadas visibles aparecen en dos grupos separados: una columna derecha y una bolsa inferior izquierda.
Un dispositivo cilíndrico numerado está situado en la unión entre las secciones principales.

silhouette: La zona principal de celdas tiene un contorno rectangular regular. Debajo de ella se ve una banda horizontal de ladrillos y un elemento numerado centrado; ambos quedan fuera del rectángulo principal de celdas.
spatial_structure: Las cinco filas superiores muestran piezas en una cuadrícula abierta. Las cuatro filas inferiores forman una matriz de celdas cubiertas, dividida en tres bloques rectangulares verticales por color. No se ven corredores o compartimentos abiertos entre esos bloques.
symmetry: Simetría bilateral marcada respecto al eje vertical: la cuadrícula es rectangular y los tres bloques inferiores están distribuidos de forma equilibrada a ambos lados del centro.
element_placement: Las piezas visibles ocupan las cinco filas superiores. Cuatro filas de celdas cubiertas ocupan la parte inferior de la cuadrícula: bloque azul a la izquierda, verde en el centro y amarillo a la derecha. Una banda de ladrillos se extiende debajo de la cuadrícula, con un elemento rojo numerado en su centro.
notable_features: Las celdas cubiertas inferiores están organizadas como tres zonas cromáticas contiguas; la banda de ladrillos visible está debajo del límite de la cuadrícula principal.

proposed_tags.why: Las cuatro filas inferiores están cubiertas, mientras que las cinco filas superiores muestran piezas abiertas.
Las celdas cubiertas se agrupan en tres bloques contiguos de colores distintos.
Una banda horizontal de ladrillos aparece inmediatamente debajo del rectángulo principal de celdas.

silhouette: El tablero visible forma dos rectángulos verticales separados por un espacio: un bloque izquierdo de cuatro columnas y una región derecha más estrecha, también de cuatro columnas.
spatial_structure: El bloque izquierdo está dividido en cuatro carriles verticales de contenedores repetidos. A la derecha hay una cuadrícula de piezas abierta y compacta. Una banda horizontal de ladrillos se extiende por debajo de ambos bloques.
symmetry: El conjunto es asimétrico: el bloque izquierdo está ocupado por contenedores repetidos, mientras que el derecho muestra piezas variadas; las dos zonas no se reflejan entre sí.
element_placement: Los contenedores cubiertos llenan los cuatro carriles de la zona izquierda. En la zona derecha, piezas de juego ocupan la cuadrícula y varias TNT aparecen en distintas filas. Ladrillos cubren la franja inferior y un elemento rojo numerado está centrado sobre ella.
notable_features: La separación visible entre los dos rectángulos crea una composición de módulos paralelos, con contenidos muy distintos a cada lado.

proposed_tags.why: Dos zonas rectangulares altas están dispuestas lado a lado y separadas por un espacio.
La zona izquierda contiene varios carriles verticales de contenedores repetidos.
Una banda continua de ladrillos ocupa la franja inferior bajo ambos módulos.

silhouette: La huella visible forma un bloque superior central que se ensancha a media altura; debajo, el tablero continúa en dos brazos laterales y deja un gran rectángulo central ocupado por un elemento naranja. La parte inferior central termina en una zona sin celdas visibles.
spatial_structure: Una franja superior compacta desemboca en un tramo transversal ancho. Más abajo, las celdas visibles quedan concentradas en dos corredores laterales; no se aprecia una ruta de celdas a través del gran elemento central.
symmetry: La estructura general es aproximadamente simétrica respecto al eje vertical, con elementos de colores distintos en posiciones no reflejadas exactamente.
element_placement: Hay fichas y potenciadores en el bloque superior; dos celdas grandes azuladas flanquean su zona inferior. Dos franjas verticales azules ocupan los brazos laterales, con una fila de cestas en sus extremos inferiores. Un único rectángulo naranja grande cubre el centro inferior visible. Se distinguen esos niveles de elementos superpuestos, sin que la imagen permita determinar capas ocultas.
notable_features: El elemento naranja central ocupa un área mucho mayor que una celda y contrasta con los corredores laterales estrechos. La imagen muestra el tablero completo, sin superposición que lo oculte.

proposed_tags.why: Debajo de la sección transversal ancha, las celdas visibles se prolongan por dos brazos laterales paralelos.
Un único elemento naranja rectangular cubre una gran zona central, a diferencia de los elementos de tamaño de celda que lo rodean.

silhouette: Bloque principal ancho y rectangular que se estrecha en una prolongación centrada hacia abajo. La extensión inferior termina alrededor de un elemento circular central.
spatial_structure: El campo forma una masa continua, con una sección inferior más estrecha que crea un cuello central. No se ven regiones desconectadas ni corredores laterales separados.
symmetry: La silueta y la extensión inferior son aproximadamente simétricas respecto al eje vertical. La distribución de fichas y elementos no es espejo exacto.
element_placement: Muchos recipientes morados ocupan celdas repartidas por el campo y se concentran en las filas inferiores y laterales. Hay fichas y potenciadores intercalados, además de un elemento circular grande en el centro de la prolongación inferior. La imagen muestra una capa de cuadrícula con esos elementos visibles.
notable_features: El elemento circular queda encajado en el cuello central inferior. El tablero se ve completo; el panel marrón bajo su borde no tapa celdas visibles.

proposed_tags.why: Un bloque ancho se prolonga hacia abajo mediante una sección más estrecha y centrada.
Un elemento circular grande ocupa el extremo inferior central del campo.

silhouette: Huella continua escalonada: un bloque rectangular alto ocupa el lado derecho y una extensión más baja sale hacia la izquierda desde su mitad inferior. Una franja de ladrillos atraviesa todo el borde inferior visible.
spatial_structure: La zona izquierda, más baja, colinda con un bloque derecho alto; ambas secciones se encuentran a lo largo de un límite vertical visible, sin separación completa. No se aprecian corredores estrechos entre ellas.
symmetry: La huella es asimétrica: el bloque derecho comienza más arriba y ocupa más altura que la extensión izquierda.
element_placement: La extensión izquierda contiene fichas y potenciadores repartidos por sus celdas. El bloque derecho está ocupado por una disposición regular de elementos ovalados cubiertos, en varias filas y columnas visibles. Una franja de ladrillos cubre la parte inferior, con un indicador rojo centrado delante de ella. La cuadrícula visible muestra esos elementos en una capa.
notable_features: El cambio escalonado de altura coincide con un contraste marcado entre fichas variadas a la izquierda y elementos ovalados repetidos a la derecha. El tablero y la franja inferior se ven completos.

proposed_tags.why: Dos zonas contiguas muestran elementos visualmente distintos: fichas variadas a la izquierda y elementos ovalados repetidos a la derecha.
Una franja continua de ladrillos se extiende a lo largo de todo el borde inferior visible.

silhouette: El contorno exterior visible es aproximadamente rectangular. En su interior, una banda vertical y otra horizontal marrones forman una cruz y delimitan cuatro zonas de esquina de tamaño parecido.
spatial_structure: La cruz central divide visualmente el campo en cuatro compartimentos de esquina. Solo el compartimento superior izquierdo muestra fichas; los otros tres aparecen cubiertos por paneles de cortina. No se ve una superposición que oculte el contorno del tablero.
symmetry: El contorno y la disposición de los compartimentos son aproximadamente simétricos en los ejes vertical y horizontal. La colocación visible de fichas y cortinas rompe esa simetría en el contenido.
element_placement: Fichas y potenciadores aparecen en el compartimento superior izquierdo. Paneles de cortina cubren las otras tres zonas de esquina; el inferior derecho tiene además un brillo visible. Las bandas marrones forman una cruz entre las zonas. Se distinguen las fichas expuestas, las cortinas y las bandas como elementos visuales diferentes.
notable_features: Una única esquina está expuesta mientras las otras tres presentan paneles de cortina; las bandas cruzadas mantienen separadas esas zonas visuales.

proposed_tags.why: Dos bandas interiores perpendiculares separan el rectángulo en cuatro compartimentos de esquina.
Tres de los cuatro compartimentos están visualmente cubiertos por paneles, mientras el superior izquierdo muestra fichas.

silhouette: Tablero ancho en la parte superior, con una prolongación rectangular más estrecha hacia abajo a la izquierda y un entrante grande en la esquina inferior derecha. El contorno del tablero es visible completo.
spatial_structure: La zona superior contiene piezas a la izquierda y un bloque amplio de tejado a la derecha. Tres bandas florales horizontales atraviesan casi todo el tablero; más abajo, una franja floral vertical conecta con la prolongación inferior, donde hay un bloque marrón amplio a la izquierda. La zona abierta inferior derecha queda fuera del contorno del tablero.
symmetry: Asimétrico respecto al eje vertical: el tejado ocupa la parte superior derecha y la prolongación inferior queda a la izquierda del centro.
element_placement: Las piezas visibles se concentran en el cuadrante superior izquierdo; el tejado cubre el cuadrante superior derecho. Se ven tres bandas florales horizontales y una franja floral vertical en la parte inferior central. Un área marrón uniforme ocupa gran parte de la prolongación inferior izquierda. No se aprecia profundidad apilada en estos elementos.
notable_features: Las bandas florales forman una barrera horizontal repetida, que se convierte en un estrecho tramo vertical en la prolongación inferior.

proposed_tags.why: Tres bandas florales horizontales atraviesan la zona principal y se enlazan con una franja vertical inferior.
El contorno se prolonga hacia abajo solo en una sección estrecha situada a la izquierda.
Un bloque visual continuo de tejado ocupa la parte superior derecha frente a las piezas de la izquierda.

silhouette: Parte superior rectangular y ancha, con prolongaciones en la zona inferior alrededor de un estrecho tramo central. El contorno visible incluye elementos emparejados en la base.
spatial_structure: Las piezas ocupan sobre todo las filas superiores. Una gran masa de bloques marrones cubre la zona central y baja; queda un corredor central estrecho que llega a la base, flanqueado por salientes y compartimentos inferiores a ambos lados.
symmetry: La estructura principal es aproximadamente simétrica respecto al eje vertical: la masa marrón y los elementos de la base se distribuyen a ambos lados del corredor central, aunque las piezas y algunos detalles difieren.
element_placement: Las piezas visibles se agrupan en la parte superior.
